llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reports are sourced from a Jotai async atom and include a refresh trigger read via `get`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: reportsAsyncAtom is defined as atom(async (get) => ...) and calls get(reportsRefreshAtom) to subscribe to the refresh trigger.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Implementation includes a helper that adapts an async atom using Jotai `unwrap` plus a derived `atom((get) => ...)` read function with try/catch error capture
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The helper uses a plain derived atom with try/catch, but does NOT use Jotai `unwrap`. The requirement explicitly calls for `unwrap` to adapt the async atom.
evidence: atoms/reports: reportsStateAtom = atom<ReportsState>((get) => { try { const data = get(reportsAsyncAtom); ... } catch ... })
No import or usage of `unwrap` from jotai anywhere in submitted files.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Helper returns explicit loadable objects for loading data and error states (including payload for data/error), and UI branches directly on that returned state shape
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Helper returns explicit {status:'loading'}, {status:'success', data}, and {status:'error', error} objects. UI branches on state.status with loading spinner, error message with state.error payload, and FlatList with state.data.
evidence: atoms/reports: ReportsLoading, ReportsSuccess, ReportsError interfaces; return { status: 'loading' }, { status: 'success', data }, { status: 'error', error }
App.tsx: state.status === 'loading', state.status === 'error' (renders state.error), state.status === 'success' (renders state.data)

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reload action updates the refresh trigger atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useSetAtom(reportsRefreshAtom) is used; handleReload calls setRefresh((c) => c + 1) which increments the refresh trigger atom, causing reportsAsyncAtom to re-execute.
evidence: App.tsx: const setRefresh = useSetAtom(reportsRefreshAtom); const handleReload = () => { setRefresh((c) => c + 1) }
